 (Old)[b]*Update 4/16/2016* Uploaded New Versions/Recolors of Farm House Exterior Retexture
[/b][img]http://i.imgur.com/0J67WDp.png[/img]


My first attempt at retexturing the farm houses.

I figured your gramps couldn't have been that terrible at farming so he left a decent little house that's not all beat up. Modified a few existing tilesets out there on the internet, recoloring, resizing, and piecing some of it together so I didn't make everything from scratch. (Thanks to modders/ sprite rippers, no names were listed, just that they were free to use). Windows, doors, lamps, style, gutters, and architecture are from scratch, with some inspiration. May have went a bit overboard with shading. Anyway, I hope ya like it.
